reviewNotes: Checked all 98 speech keys against source furigana. Topic は and contrastive には become わ and にわ; object を is お. Lexical は in はんなま and へ in へんじ remain unchanged. The English medium inside the Japanese question is explicitly read みでぃあむ. Individual choices and joined choices share reviewed readings. No audible pitch certification.
